content:
maya: heads-up :warning: hotfix 1.8.3 — we're seeing a memory leak in the batcher at high throughput. need a minimal patch, bump patch version and expedite cutoff for today's deploy (target cutoff ~ 2:00pm PT, ~90m). who can cut the branch and do the cherry-pick?

ops-bot: CI pipeline queued for hotfix/1.8.3 — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/98765 (smoke + unit triggered automatically)

alex: I can pair on review; who owns the actual cut?

cheng: I can cut it. what's the exact commit to cherry-pick?

maya: @cheng commit is abcdef123456 (the commit that fixes KV cache retention). minimal steps below — keep PR tiny, do not add extra deps.

```
# create branch and cherry-pick
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix/1.8.3 origin/release/1.8.x
git cherry-pick abcdef123456
# run smoke + unit locally, then push
git push origin hotfix/1.8.3
# open PR against release/1.8.x
gh pr create --base release/1.8.x --head hotfix/1.8.3 --title "hotfix: v1.8.3 - fix batcher memory leak" --body "minimal patch: cherry-pick abcdef123456"
```

cheng: thanks. I'll cut it now and request review from @alex + @tara. will run smoke + unit only (skip full matrix) — we should be fine for patch.

release-council: Reminder: patch releases require one approver from "release-council" team and CI: smoke, unit, e2e-smoke green. If tests pass, tagging will be automatic.

tara: I'll add the changelog entry (short). Suggest: "1.8.3 — Fix memory leak in batcher under high-throughput workloads (cherry-pick abcdef123456)." Keep it one line under Unreleased -> 1.8.x.

sam: can we short-circuit the full integration matrix for this hotfix? smoke + e2e-smoke should be enough given the narrow change.

maya: agree with @sam. ops: please prioritize smoke + e2e-smoke so we can meet cutoff. If anything flaps, fall back to rollback policy.

ops-bot: Prioritizing jobs: smoke, e2e-smoke. Full matrix queued with low priority.

nidhi: do we need to backport to any other branches? e.g., release/1.7.x?

maya: not necessary — this bug was introduced in 1.8.x series only. no backport to 1.7.x.

cheng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4211 — requested reviewers @alex @tara. CI smoke + unit passed locally, pushing to origin now.

alex: reviewing now :eyes: — will prioritize.

release-council: Tagging workflow: after approver + required CI, tag v1.8.3 will be created and release pipeline triggered.

ops-bot: CI update: smoke ✅, unit ✅, e2e-smoke queued.

alex: approved. looks tiny, no API changes. :shipit:

release-council: Approved by alex, creating tag v1.8.3-rc1 for verification.

ops-bot: Tag v1.8.3-rc1 created. Release pipeline started: https://ci.redwood.example/releases/1234

maya: thanks team — feel free to merge once e2e-smoke is green and release pipeline completes. I'll monitor post-release. Cutoff still 2:00pm PT but we'll aim earlier if CI finishes.

cheng: merging once e2e-smoke ✅.

ops-bot: e2e-smoke ✅. Release pipeline succeeded. v1.8.3 published.
summary: Hotfix 1.8.3 coordination: cherry-pick, expedited cutoff, CI prioritization, changelog and tagging
